resources.string: Web plugins are web pages written by their developer. CyanBridge cannot verify who made a package (MemoMind publishes no signing keys). Install only plugins you trust: each runs in a sandbox and gets only the permissions you allow.
No Web plugins installed. Build one with the MemoMind PhoneSDK and install its .mmpkg file.
MemoMind is not connected. Plugins still open, but the display, glasses messages and the microphone need the glasses.

The Web Bridge plugin is not running on the glasses. Only the official MemoMind app can start glasses plugins: start Web Bridge (or the plugin\'s own glasses plugin) there, force-stop the official app, then reconnect CyanBridge. Until then, plugin text goes to the native teleprompter, and images, frames and glasses buttons are unavailable.
Web Bridge is running on the glasses.
Needs the glasses plugin %1$s, which only the official MemoMind app can install and start.
The plugin, its stored data and your permission choices are deleted.
Replaces the installed version %1$s. Its stored data is kept.
Not a valid MemoMind Web plugin: %1$s
Could not read the selected file.
Required permissions must be allowed to start the plugin. You can change these later from the plugin list.
Android System WebView on this phone is too old to run Web plugins safely. Update Android System WebView and try again.
%1$s is recording from the glasses microphone
Keep its own small saved data
Open files you pick (not available in CyanBridge)
Read the glasses model, firmware and battery
Receive glasses buttons and head gestures
Exchange messages with the glasses plugin
Use your location (not available in CyanBridge)
